activity.notes: Broad conventional window for Sisera in the Judges 4–5 conflict tradition. The primary polity is Hazor because the narrative identifies Sisera as the commander of Jabin, the king associated with Hazor. This supersedes the earlier Israel conflict-theater workaround and does not claim independent extra-biblical confirmation of Sisera.

sources.title: Hebrew Bible — Judges 4–5
sources.citation_text: Primary textual source for Sisera as the commander of Jabin associated with Hazor and as the military opponent of Deborah and Barak.

review_context.canonical_name_policy: Preserve the existing Sisera Person identity. Do not use the opposing conflict theater as the primary polity when the primary source places the person under another ruler/political center.
